notes: Run each prompt in a fresh agent with the skills available and a scratch copy of the fixture. Grade against must and must_not. Seeded defects are listed in evals/README.md.

evals.prompt: Audit the design of weak-settings.html. Don't change anything yet.
must: No file is modified
Findings are ranked, contrast failures first
Each finding has a location, a measurement and a rule id
Reports the header text contrast (about 1.6:1) and the grey footer text on the page background (about 3.9:1)
Reports that all text is 16px regular, so roles are indistinguishable
Reports the centered card beside left-aligned cards
Reports heavy black borders and the 45% shadow
must_not: Proposes new fonts or a new brand color
Findings stated as taste without a measurement

evals.prompt: The typography on weak-settings.html is flat, everything looks the same. Fix just the typography.
must: Card headings become clearly distinct from body text, by weight first and size if needed
Eyebrow and metadata are quieter than headings and still pass 4.5:1
Font family is unchanged
Borders, shadows, layout and brand color are unchanged
Heading elements stay heading elements
Other severe issues (contrast of header text, borders) are listed as residual, not fixed
must_not: Adds an uppercase tracked eyebrow style without asking
Introduces more than three text tiers in a card

evals.prompt: This settings page feels messy and I can't tell what the main action is. Tidy the layout.
must: The centered Owner card is left-aligned to match its neighbours
Each card has a single left edge for heading, text and controls
One filled primary action; Discard and other secondary actions are visibly quieter
Oversized buttons are scaled down and spacing snaps to the existing --space tokens
Phone and Email are stacked vertically
The duplicate Support heading is raised as a gated copy change, not silently deleted
Layout still collapses to one column under 720px
must_not: Reorders DOM to change visual order
Changes colors beyond what secondary-button quieting requires

evals.prompt: Elevate weak-settings.html. Keep it recognisably the same product.
must: Before and after screenshots at the same viewports, or an explicit statement that no browser tooling was available
All text passes WCAG AA after the change, verified by measurement
Brand purple (--brand) is still the accent; typeface unchanged
Heavy black borders and heading rules are removed or reduced to 1px low contrast; inputs keep a perceivable boundary
Shadow is removed or reduced to a subtle value
The saturated plan card flood is flagged or reduced, with the reasoning stated
Changes are made in the :root tokens and shared selectors rather than inline styles
Focus is visible on inputs and buttons; page has no horizontal overflow at 375px
Report lists changes with before and after values, validation results and residual issues
must_not: Rewrites the markup structure or removes sections without approval
Introduces a new visual style (gradients, glass, neubrutalism, new palette)

evals.prompt: Make the color on weak-settings.html better.
must: Header text is changed to a passing color from the existing tokens
Muted text on the page background is fixed via the --muted token after checking it on every surface it is used on
If --brand itself is to change, the agent asks first and reports the measured ratio

evals.prompt: Add a new 'API keys' section to the settings page with a table of keys and a create button.
must: Treated as a feature build; the lift skills are not the driver
If consulted at all, only to match existing styles
must_not: Runs a design audit or restyles existing sections unprompted
